mapper.sql: pur.id AS relation_id, p.id AS patient_id, p.name, pur.relationship, pur.is_default, p.gender, p.date_of_birth AS birthday, p.phone_ciphertext AS phone, p.id_card_ciphertext AS id_card_no, p.emergency_contact, pur.created_at, pur.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM patient_user_relation pur INNER JOIN patient p ON p.id = pur.patient_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE pur.user_id = #{userId} AND pur.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN pur.relationship = 'SELF' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, pur.created_at ASC, pur.id ASC
SELECT id FROM c_user WHERE id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM patient_user_relation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND relationship <> 'SELF' AND deleted_at IS NULL
